en-US.description: Upload product images, choose a reference background or text background, and generate polished product background swaps.
en-US.error.backgroundImageRequired: Please choose a reference background image
en-US.error.aiPromptEmpty: AI did not return a valid background prompt. Please try again.
en-US.error.aiPromptUnavailable: AI prompt completion is temporarily unavailable
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.help.backgroundImage: Use a simple background reference with a similar camera angle and composition to the product image.
en-US.help.backgroundPrompt: Works best when the product is detailed and the target background is relatively simple. More specific descriptions usually produce more stable results.
en-US.label: Product Background Swap
en-US.placement.background.desc: Keep the product angle and pose as unchanged as possible while blending with the new background.
en-US.placement.natural.desc: Let shoes, bags, bottles, decor objects, and other hard goods sit naturally in the scene.
en-US.placement.replace.desc: When the reference already contains a similar product, inherit its placement 1:1.
en-US.placement.smart.desc: Automatically choose same-position replacement, hard-product styling, or soft-garment styling.
en-US.placement.soft.desc: Lay, drape, fold, or hang garments like pants, tops, and skirts instead of standing them upright.
en-US.placeholder.backgroundPrompt: Enter a background direction, for example: light gray studio backdrop, soft side lighting, clean shadow...
en-US.toast.aiPromptSoon: AI prompt generation is coming soon
en-US.toast.success: Product background swap image generated successfully!
en-US.upload.productImageTip: Supports multiple product images (up to 10). Use only product images you own or are authorized to use.

zh-CN.description: 上传商品图，选择参考背景图或文生背景，快速生成商业级商品换背景效果图。
zh-CN.error.aiPromptEmpty: AI 未生成有效背景提示词，请重试
zh-CN.error.aiPromptUnavailable: AI 提示词补全能力暂不可用
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.help.backgroundImage: 建议使用与商品原图视角、构图相近的简单背景图。
zh-CN.help.backgroundPrompt: 适合商品细节复杂、背景相对简单的场景；描述越具体，背景越稳定。
zh-CN.label: 商品换背景
zh-CN.placement.background.desc: 商品角度和姿态尽量不变，只做背景与光影融合。
zh-CN.placement.natural.desc: 鞋、包、瓶罐、摆件等硬质商品自然落入场景。
zh-CN.placement.replace.desc: 参考图已有同类商品时，1:1 继承原商品摆放。
zh-CN.placement.smart.desc: 自动判断同类替换、硬质摆拍或柔软衣物摆放。
zh-CN.placement.soft.desc: 裤子、上衣、裙子等平铺、搭放或挂放，不直立。
zh-CN.placeholder.backgroundPrompt: 输入背景描述内容，如：浅灰色摄影棚背景，柔和侧光，干净阴影...
zh-CN.toast.aiPromptSoon: AI 生成功能即将上线
zh-CN.toast.success: 商品换背景图生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.productImageTip: 支持多图（最多 10 张），请确保仅使用本人或已合法授权的商品图。
